INSERT INTO REGISTER_PROD ( REG_ID, PACKAGE_ID, REG_TITLE, REG_DATE, REG_PRICE, REG_QTY, FOR_SALE, START_DT, END_DT, SALE_START_DT, SALE_END_DT, HIGHLIGHT, DESCRIPTION_A, DESCRIPTION_B ) VALUES ( #{regId}, #{pkgId}, #{regTitle}, SYSDATE, #{regPrice}, #{regQty}, #{forSale}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{saleStartDt}, #{saleEndDt}, #{highlight}, #{descriptionA}, #{descriptionB} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.reg_id AS regId, p.package_id AS packageId, p.package_title AS packageTitle, p.theme_id AS themeId, t.theme_title AS themeTitle FROM register_PROD r JOIN packageS p ON p.package_id = r.package_id JOIN p_theme t ON t.theme_id = p.theme_id WHERE r.reg_id = #{regId}

SELECT pi.item_id AS itemId, i.item_title AS itemTitle, l.loc_id AS locId, l.loc_name AS locName, c.ctry_id AS ctryId, c.ctry_name AS ctryName, pi.by_date AS byDate FROM register_PROD r JOIN packageS p ON p.package_id = r.package_id JOIN package_item pi ON pi.package_id = p.package_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id = pi.item_id LEFT JOIN location l ON l.loc_id = i.loc_id LEFT JOIN country c ON c.ctry_id = l.ctry_id WHERE r.reg_id = #{regId} ORDER BY pi.by_date
